$comment: DRAFT SOURCE DATA — NOT APPROVED. Derived from the indexed text of AICTE APH 2024-27 Clause 6.46 'Release of Security Deposit' as recorded in docs/spec/SPEC_v3.md §2.3 [R1]. The policy owner must verify against the final downloadable PDF, current amendments, and applicability per case (D-01, D-02). Each checklist row resolves to SATISFIED / NOT SATISFIED / PENDING SOURCE / NOT APPLICABLE with deciding user, evidence link, rule version and reason. 'All documents uploaded' is NOT clearance.

checklist.label: Institution request/application letter for FDR / RTGS release
checklist.boundary: Do not auto-accept a blank/malformed letter; policy owner defines template/mandatory fields.

checklist.label: Affidavit 6 (institution and Trust/Society/Company details; FDR/RTGS details)
checklist.boundary: Store template/version and submission date; corrected versions keep history.

checklist.label: Copy of FDR to be released; for corpus fund created by RPGF, DD copies if applicable; or online security-deposit payment proof
checklist.boundary: File present ≠ authentic or credited; use the separate verification process.

checklist.label: Copy of latest LoA / EoA
checklist.boundary: Policy owner defines acceptable official source and validity/version checks.

checklist.label: Clearance — PGRC
checklist.boundary: Never infer clear from empty queue, missing data or integration outage.

checklist.label: Clearance — other AICTE Cells/Bureaus relevant to grants released to the institution
NOC from Approval Bureau (FDR/RPGF path)
checklist.boundary: Portal never issues a substitute for the official NOC.

checklist.label: Sanction order issued by Council (RTGS path)
checklist.boundary: Keep distinct from REL-08; never issue a portal-generated sanction order.

checklist.label: Where financial embezzlement with a Government body/bank exists: NOC from that body before any release
checklist.boundary: Do not infer from an AI score; official owner records basis and evidence.

reference_note: APH also states the Council may initiate penal action for security-deposit norm violations. The portal must not calculate or impose penalty (see penalties.blocked.json).
